gui.projectbench.project_bench.active_he: Shift-click, the tabs, JEI and EMI, Record and Fill work on the active grid. Balance and Clear belong to each grid. Both grids still craft by hand. Click, or press the key (Tab unless you changed it in Controls), to change.
gui.projectbench.project_bench.auto_help: After a craft, when the last item of a grid slot is used up, it takes one from the internal inventory (and the ones beside the bench when sharing). Click to change: red, yellow, green.
gui.projectbench.project_bench.auto_item: Auto: keeps one of the same item
gui.projectbench.project_bench.auto_off: Auto: off (the grid empties as a crafting table's does)
gui.projectbench.project_bench.auto_tags: Auto: the same item, or another the recipe accepts
gui.projectbench.project_bench.autocraft: On: a redstone pulse crafts once and sends the result to the inventory below (out the back, for the ejecting bench), and a hopper or pipe below takes results out by crafting them. Click to change.
gui.projectbench.project_bench.balance_h: Spreads each item evenly over the grid slots it already holds.
gui.projectbench.project_bench.clear_hel: Puts the grid's items back in the internal inventory, then in the inventories beside the bench when it shares, then in your inventory. What fits nowhere stays in the grid.
gui.projectbench.project_bench.cost_help: Each recording spends %s × %s from this slot. Only that item goes in here.
gui.projectbench.project_bench.fill_help: Lays the grid out as the blueprint says, with as many items as the stock can give.
gui.projectbench.project_bench.hands_off: You cannot take items out of this inventory or put them in by hand.
gui.projectbench.project_bench.locked_he: The game's limited crafting rule is on and this recipe is not in your recipe book yet.
gui.projectbench.project_bench.record_he: Writes the grid's recipe on the blank blueprint in the slot. It spends nothing.
Writes the grid's recipe on the blank blueprint in the slot, and spends %s × %s from the slot above it.
gui.projectbench.project_bench.record_mi: Missing %s × %s in the slot above the blueprint
gui.projectbench.project_bench.share_hel: What the bench takes from the inventories beside it and sends to them: a craft that would empty a grid slot refills it from them, «clear» and «fill» use them, and shift-click sends things there. Click to change.
gui.projectbench.project_bench.share_non: Sharing none of the inventories beside the bench
gui.projectbench.project_bench.share_all: Sharing every inventory beside the bench
gui.projectbench.project_bench.showcase_: On: the items of the grid are drawn on top of the bench, and what they make floats over them. Click to change.
Not showing the grid on the bench
Showing the grid on the bench
item.projectbench.blueprint.blank: Blank: record a recipe on it in a project bench
key.projectbench.switch_matrix: Project Station: switch the active grid
message.projectbench.feature_disabled: %s is turned off in this game's configuration
